A listing that tells the directory one WooCommerce and the shop another.

== Description ==

"WC tested up to" is written twice: here, where the public directory reads it,
and in the plugin header, where WooCommerce reads it to decide whether to warn
the merchant that the plugin has not been tested with the version they are
running. Raising it in one place alone gives the two readers two different
answers to the same question, and neither of them can see the other.

Everything else in this listing is coherent, so the report has to name these two
values and only these.
